name: radioly_client_api

ci_notes.impacted_tests: scripts/get_impacted_tests.py walks up to a sibling tests/ dir and can miss co-located test_*.py (e.g. v3/content/latam_modules/test_views.py → wrongly v3/content/tests). Always keep module tests co-located AND ensure Groot/CI run those files explicitly.
ci_notes.diff_cover: PR pytest workflow fails under 80% diff-cover on changed production .py files. New lines must be executed by the impacted test set.

mocking_rules: Unit tests must not open MySQL, Redis, Scylla, ES, or Kafka. Follow existing pytest fixtures.
